skills.name: ubuntu-sysadmin
skills.description: Ubuntu Linux system administration: manage services, install packages, configure networking, inspect logs, manage users, tune kernel parameters, secure a server, or diagnose system issues. Covers systemd, apt, ufw, netplan, journalctl, SSH hardening, and performance tuning.

skills.name: fedora-sysadmin
skills.description: Fedora Linux system administration: manage services, install packages via dnf, configure networking with NetworkManager/nmcli, manage firewalld, troubleshoot SELinux, inspect logs, manage users, tune kernel parameters, or diagnose system issues. Covers dnf, systemd, firewalld, SELinux, journalctl, SSH hardening, and performance tuning.
